_comment: Committed PDK defaults for this repo. Environment variables win over this
file, and sim/pdk.local.json (git-ignored) wins over both.
variant       gf180mcu flavor directory to use (A/B/C/D differ in metal stack)
search_roots  extra directories that CONTAIN variant dirs, searched before
variant is pinned to gf180mcuD because that is the variant spec/tmds-tx.md's
ratified decision records (DR-0002, DR-0005) cite. This is a PIN, not a
resolution of the gf180mcuC-vs-gf180mcuD discrepancy against this repo's
existing layout evidence (spec/pad-ring-esd-survey.md, layout/ from #2, which
was produced against gf180mcuC) -- that discrepancy is an open question owned
by #9 and is intentionally NOT ruled on here. See sim/README.md's 'PDK
